artworks.title: Erosion of Discourse
artworks.description: Autonomous agents wander a rigid grid, leaving trails of gray — proving that reality is not binary.

artworks.title: Vanishing Green
artworks.description: 38 years of Amazon deforestation visualized with real satellite data from INPE and NASA FIRMS.

artworks.title: Urban Sunset
artworks.description: Shader-driven sky with layered clouds over a procedural cityscape silhouette.

artworks.title: Aurora Boreal
artworks.description: Generative northern lights: curtains of light ripple across a starlit sky above a silhouetted mountain ridge.

artworks.title: Opus — Audio Explanation of Life
artworks.description: A geometric mandala that breathes with Eric Prydz's Opus. One unified visualization continuously scales from silence to full psychedelic intensity, driven by a smooth energy curve matched to the song and real-time FFT analysis.

artworks.title: Time Dilation
artworks.description: Concentric time rings visualizing relativistic time dilation near a black hole. Inner rings crawl, outer rings spin freely.

artworks.title: Endurance — Relativistic Clock
artworks.description: Three clock hands sweep at different gravitational time rates — Earth, orbit, and Miller's planet — making relativistic time dilation tangible through real system time.

artworks.title: Eye of God
artworks.description: The Helix Nebula reimagined in GLSL — domain-warped noise sculpts gas clouds around an asymmetric ring, from crimson outer halo through amber ring to a blue stellar core, floating in a dense starfield.
